sql: SELECT loan.account_id, loan.amount FROM loan loan JOIN account account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE loan.duration > 12 AND account.date LIKE '1993%' AND loan.amount = (SELECT MAX(loan.amount) FROM loan loan JOIN account account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE loan.duration > 12 AND account.date LIKE '1993%')
